status: verdict roles measured on 100 common cases (original bench prompt); implementation measured on easy F13 cases only (every arm 5/5, so the default is chosen on cost); harder multi-file cases unmeasured
selection_rule: Maximize pass rate first. Among arms tied for the best pass rate within sampling noise, pick the fewest tokens and quota, then the fastest. Never trade pass rate for savings.
how_to_revise: Edit this file only. /ulw reads it at the start of a task; no code or rules change needed. Record the evidence in docs/model-routing.md.

plan.note: Carbon dropped: Carbon high matched Argon high when it answered (72.1% vs 72.7% on 100 cases) but its median was 212 s, so a 180 s cap cut off more than half its calls and they fell back to Argon anyway

long_context.note: only role left for Carbon: documents beyond ~250k tokens

security_audit.note: Carbon high missed fewer bad cases (4/67 vs 7/67) but 14/100 failed or timed out; Argon high is the audit model

verdict_review.note: 100 common cases: Argon high 72/100 exact, 1 error, 38 s median; Hydrogen high 65/100 with the most clean false alarms (10/33)

implementation.note: single session; pass 5/5 at ~17.5k tokens, ~32 s, ~0.01 weekly pts per 5 cases. Hydrogen high is the same pass rate (~22.8k tokens, ~28 s).

long_execution.note: test-verified execution only (long or flaky steps); never a gate: most clean false alarms on 100 cases (10/33) and 36% on the v2 retest

pii_inject_docfmt.note: with the original prompt PII was weak for every model (best 3/6 on the 100-case set); with the v2 prompt Hydrogen xhigh/Argon/Carbon reached inject 32/32 and pii 38/38 (clean false positives 0/24 for xhigh)

single.use_when: 1-2 files, sequential work, or any task where one session can finish it
single.status: default (measured best on cost: 5/5 at ~17.5k tokens)

subagents.use_when: 3+ truly independent lanes with disjoint files
subagents.status: measured 5/5 at ~33k tokens, ~131 s (about 2x tokens, 4x time vs single); use only when lanes are independent

swarm.use_when: wide parallel work that needs verifiers; propose first, quota heavy
swarm.status: measured 3/3 at ~87k tokens, ~250 s, ~0.27 weekly pts per case (about 25x single); not a default

boost.use_when: one hard problem where a single attempt failed
boost.status: measured 2/2 at ~27.5k tokens, ~100 s on easy cases; keep for hard single problems, unmeasured on hard ones

teamwork.use_when: multi-day work that needs an interview first; propose it, do not start it silently

orchestrator_builtin.status: measured 5/5 at ~47k tokens, ~110 s (about 2.7x tokens, 3.4x time vs single)

lazy_pipeline.use_when: not a default; the 3-stage plan/work/review pipeline
lazy_pipeline.status: measured 5/5 at ~109k tokens, ~182 s (about 6x tokens); lazyorch variant 5/5 at ~79k tokens

quota_guard.note: below these, drop to the cheapest mode that still meets the pass-rate rule and say so
